name: android-filesystem-tools
description: F2FS and ext2/3/4 filesystem creation tools for Android development

tools.description: F2FS formatter with encryption and zoned block device support
tools.usage:
make_f2fs -f -l system /dev/sdX # Format with label and force
make_f2fs -O encrypt -C utf8:strict /dev/sdX # Encrypted with casefolding
make_f2fs -s 1 -z 4 -o 7 /dev/sdX # Custom segments/zones/overprovision
make_f2fs -e mp3,mp4,jpg -E db,log /dev/sdX # Hot/cold file extensions
make_f2fs -T 1234567890 -U $(uuidgen) /dev/sdX # Custom timestamp and UUID

tools.description: F2FS formatter optimized for case-insensitive operations
tools.usage: make_f2fs_casefold -O casefold -C utf8 /dev/sdX # Standard casefolding\nmake_f2fs_casefold -f -l userdata /dev/sdX # Force format with label\nmake_f2fs_casefold -q -S /dev/sdX # Quiet sparse mode format

tools.description: Ext2/3/4 creator with journal, quota, and encryption features
tools.usage:
mke2fs -t ext4 -F -L system /dev/sdX # Force ext4 with label
mke2fs -j -O dir_index,extent /dev/sdX # Ext3 with performance features
mke2fs -T largefile4 -O quota /dev/sdX # Large file optimized with quota
mke2fs -E quotatype=usrquota:grpquota /dev/sdX # Enable user/group quotas
mke2fs -O encrypt -F /dev/sdX # Encrypted ext4 filesystem
